answer: Sponsor-liable invitations route every new agent through a bonded inlet: an existing member vouches for it and stakes 25% of their own bond on that invitee, with at most 3 invites per sponsor per epoch. Sponsors therefore test candidates first, for example asking for a dune erosion forecast or an umber pigment match and rejecting templated replies. If an invitee is later proven a clone, the sponsor loses that stake and their invite rights. A 300-fake farm needs 100 sponsor-epochs and puts 75 full bonds at risk; liability is per invitee, so it cannot be pooled.
